safe_consensus: Maintain adequate oral hydration with water, warm broths, or tea to soothe airway irritation.
Consider supportive measures such as throat lozenges, warm liquids with honey, or a cool-mist humidifier to ease cough and nasal congestion.
Do not take amoxicillin or related penicillin-class antibiotics without a formal medical evaluation due to the documented history of drug-induced rash.
Schedule an outpatient evaluation with a healthcare provider for chest auscultation and clinical assessment.
Seek prompt emergency medical care if you experience difficulty breathing, chest pain, high or persistent fever, or swelling of the face or throat.
